description: 한국수자원공사_다목적댐 발전량 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수자원공사. 다목적댐은 홍수 조절, 용수 공급, 수력발전 등 다양한 기능을 수행하며, 이 중 발전량은 전력 생산과 국가 전력 수급 계획 수립에 중요한 지표로 활용됩니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수자원공사. Its tags are 전ㄹ녁생산, 발전 실적, 전력거래량, 전력생산, 발전효율. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
